item.text:
Implemented structured Wikidata profiles and displayed them in the author infobox. Wikipedia links use the requested language with English fallback; Google Scholar profiles use P1960, including multiple identifiers. I also restored the author’s Wikidata lookup and added the referenced icons.

Verification: all 8 Wikidata tests pass; `git diff --check` passes.
